title: Formation of supported lipid bilayers of charged E. coli lipids on modified gold by vesicle fusion
author: Márquez, Vélez

steps.title: Prepare standard buffers
steps.instruction: Make two buffer solutions: (i) 10 mM Tris‑HCl, 200 mM NaCl, adjust to pH 7.5 with NaOH; (ii) 0.1 M Na2HPO4, adjust to pH 5.5, each prepared with Milli‑Q water, filtered through a 0.2 µm cellulose syringe filter and, for QCM experiments only, degassed for 1 h at room temperature using a Bransonic B‑2510 ultrasonic cleaner in degassing mode. Add 2 mM CaCl2 to either buffer when required.

steps.title: Prepare liposomes by extrusion
steps.instruction: In a round‑bottom flask add the desired amount of lipid stock solution, dry under a gentle nitrogen stream for 30 min, then hydrate the film with the appropriate buffer and vortex for 30 min until a homogeneous multilamellar vesicle (MLV) suspension is obtained. Extrude the MLVs through an Avanti mini‑extruder using a polycarbonate membrane of 50 nm or 200 nm pore size to generate large unilamellar vesicles (LUVs). Store liposome suspensions in airtight containers at 4 °C for no longer than one week.

steps.title: Determine detergent amount
steps.instruction: Perform a solubility curve with dodecyl‑β‑D‑maltoside (DDM) by measuring absorbance at 350 nm while increasing detergent concentration. Identify the concentration at which the absorbance falls below 60 % of the initial value; this is the amount of DDM required for partial destabilization of the liposomes before fusion.

steps.title: Clean AFM gold substrates
steps.instruction: Immerse gold substrates in piranha solution (3 : 1 H2SO4 98 % / H2O2 30 %) and rinse extensively with Milli‑Q water. Anneal each substrate by passing a propane flame over it until it glows orange for a few seconds; repeat the flame treatment twelve times to produce atomically flat Au(111) terraces.

steps.title: Clean QCM crystals
steps.instruction: For SiO2‑coated crystals: clean in 2 % (w/v) SDS solution for 15 min, rinse thoroughly with distilled water, dry under nitrogen, then expose to a UV/ozone cleaner for at least 30 min before mounting. For Au‑coated crystals: clean with the same piranha solution as above, rinse with Milli‑Q water and dry under nitrogen.

steps.title: Form mercaptopropionic acid SAM
steps.instruction: Submerge the cleaned gold surfaces in 0.2 mM 3‑mercaptopropionic acid prepared in a 1 : 1 (v/v) mixture of deionized water and ethanol at room temperature and leave overnight (≈18 h) to allow self‑assembled monolayer formation. Rinse the SAM‑covered substrates with Milli‑Q water and dry immediately with nitrogen before use.

steps.title: Incubate partially solubilized liposomes
steps.instruction: Dilute the liposome suspension to 0.1 mg mL⁻¹ with the chosen buffer. For AFM measurements, add the partially solubilized liposomes to the SAM‑modified gold, incubate overnight at room temperature in the presence of Bio‑beads, then rinse with buffer to remove non‑adsorbed vesicles before imaging. For QCM‑D measurements, first establish a baseline by flowing buffer through the chamber, then inject the temperature‑equilibrated partially solubilized liposome solution, allow adsorption, and finally rinse the chamber with buffer to eliminate excess vesicles. Clean the flow module with Milli‑Q water and dry with nitrogen before and after each measurement.

steps.title: Regenerate surface with SDS rinse
steps.instruction: To remove an existing supported lipid bilayer, rinse the SAM‑modified gold in the QCM‑D chamber with 1 % (w/v) SDS solution, then rinse thoroughly with buffer. The mercaptopropionic acid monolayer remains intact, allowing repeated bilayer formation.
